469.text: "Amid this corporate renaissance, we must make sure Rizia's traditional, family-run businesses do not get run out of town by newer, foreign-influenced competitors."

473.speaker: Narrator
473.text: "Amid our flourishing business climate, we must take care to uplift the citizenry and nobility alike."

474.speaker: Narrator
474.text: "Greater cooperation between the Crown and the Rizian business community will only compound this."

483.text: "Looking to the future, we are expected to continue running an energy surplus, enabling us to meet our partners' demands while seeking new frontiers at home and abroad."

497.speaker: Narrator
